item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 03/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The upper-air disturbances will depart from Guangdong tomorrow, rain will ease off gradually over the region. Meanwhile, the northeast monsoon will bring cool weather to the region. Under the influence of a relatively dry replenishment of the monsoon, the weather will improve gradually over the coast of Guangdong in the following couple of days. A strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week.

Date/Month: 04/03 (Wednesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few rain patches. Cool in the morning. Rain will ease off gradually later.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
